Yuan.name: Kublai
Yuan.title: Emperor Shizu (Kublai Khan)
Yuan.note: Great Khan from 1260; proclaimed the Yuan dynasty in 1271.
Yuan.note_zh: 1260年即大汗位，1271年定国号为大元。

Southern Song.name: Zhao Xian
Southern Song.title: Emperor Gong
Southern Song.note: A small child; surrendered to the Yuan in 1276.

Southern Song.name: Zhao Bing
Southern Song.title: Last Emperor of Song
Southern Song.note: Drowned at Yamen in 1279, carried into the sea by Lu Xiufu.
Southern Song.note_zh: 1279年崖山兵败，由陆秀夫背负投海。

Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).name: Go-Daigo
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).title: Emperor Go-Daigo
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note: Overthrew the Kamakura shogunate in 1333; from 1336 led the Southern Court against a rival Northern Court.
Imperial Japan (Fujiwara).note_zh: 1333年推翻镰仓幕府；1336年起建立南朝，与北朝对峙。

Shogun Japan (Kamakura).name: Hōjō Tokimune
Shogun Japan (Kamakura).title: Regent (shikken)
Shogun Japan (Kamakura).note: Led Japan's defence against both Mongol invasions.
Shogun Japan (Kamakura).note_zh: 主持抵抗元军两次入侵。

Đại Việt.name: Trần Khâm
Đại Việt.title: Trần Nhân Tông
Đại Việt.note: Defeated the Mongol invasions of 1285 and 1287–1288 with the general Trần Hưng Đạo.
Đại Việt.note_zh: 与大将陈兴道一起击退1285年和1287—1288年的元军入侵。

sides.name: Song garrison of Xiangyang and Fancheng

xiangyang.note: Muslim engineers built the counterweight trebuchets ('Huihui pao') that broke the walls.
xiangyang.note_zh: 回回工匠制造的配重投石机（回回炮）最终攻破了城防。

sides.name: Yuan and Goryeo army
sides.troops_text: c. 900 ships; about 23,000 soldiers plus sailors (estimate)
sides.troops_text_zh: 约900艘船，士兵约2.3万，另有水手（估计）

bunei-invasion.note: The invaders won ground on the first day but withdrew to their ships, and a storm then sank many of them.
bunei-invasion.note_zh: 元军首日占了上风，但随后撤回船上，归途又遭风暴，损失惨重。

linan-falls.note: The capital surrendered without a final battle.

sides.name: Last Song fleet
sides.troops_text: over 1,000 ships; about 200,000 people, many of them civilians (traditional figure)
sides.troops_text_zh: 战船千余艘，军民约20万（传统说法）

yamen.losses: The Song fleet destroyed; the boy emperor drowned
yamen.losses_zh: 宋军全军覆没，幼帝投海而死

japan-invasion.note: The samurai held a stone wall along Hakata Bay for weeks before a typhoon struck the fleet.
japan-invasion.note_zh: 日本武士依靠博多湾沿岸的石墙坚守数周，随后台风摧毁了元军船队。
japan-invasion.losses: Most of the fleet lost in the typhoon

red-turbans.note: Liu Futong's northern Red Turbans were crushed by 1363, but the revolt broke Yuan power in the south and raised up Zhu Yuanzhang.
red-turbans.note_zh: 刘福通的北方红巾军到1363年已被镇压，但起义瓦解了元朝在南方的统治，也造就了朱元璋。

poyang.note: Numbers are from traditional accounts and are probably inflated; Zhu used fire ships against Chen's huge tower ships.
poyang.note_zh: 兵力为传统说法，可能夸大。朱元璋用火船攻击陈友谅的巨型楼船。
poyang.losses: Chen Youliang killed by an arrow

pingjiang.losses: Zhang Shicheng captured and later killed himself

routes.name: Bayan's campaign down the Yangtze
routes.summary: From Xiangyang the Yuan army sailed down the Han and the Yangtze and took Lin'an.
routes.summary_zh: 元军从襄阳出发，沿汉水、长江顺流而下，攻占临安。

routes.name: Flight of the last Song court
routes.summary: Loyalists carried two boy emperors down the coast to Yamen, where the Song ended.
routes.summary_zh: 忠臣护卫两位幼帝沿海南逃，最终在崖山覆灭。

routes.name: First Mongol invasion of Japan
routes.summary: The fleet sailed from Korea by Tsushima and Iki to Hakata Bay.
routes.summary_zh: 船队从朝鲜半岛出发，经对马、壹岐抵达博多湾。

routes.name: Second invasion of Japan: the southern fleet
routes.name_zh: 元朝第二次东征日本（江南军）
routes.summary: The large southern fleet left Qingyuan (Ningbo) and was wrecked by a typhoon off Takashima.
routes.summary_zh: 江南军从庆元（宁波）出发，在鹰岛附近被台风摧毁。

routes.name: Yuan Grand Canal
routes.summary: New cuts through Shandong let grain barges sail straight from Hangzhou to Dadu.
routes.summary_zh: 元朝在山东开凿新河道，使运粮船可从杭州直达大都。

routes.name: Marco Polo's journey to China
routes.summary: According to his book, the Venetian crossed the Pamirs and the Silk Road to Kublai's summer capital Shangdu.
routes.summary_zh: 据他的游记，这位威尼斯人翻越帕米尔高原，沿丝绸之路来到忽必烈的上都。

routes.name: Zhu Yuanzhang's march to Nanjing
routes.summary: From Haozhou Zhu moved south, crossed the Yangtze near Caishi and took Jiqing (Nanjing).
routes.summary_zh: 朱元璋从濠州南下，在采石一带渡江，攻占集庆（南京）。

people.name: Guan Hanqing
people.known_for: The leading playwright of Yuan drama (zaju).
people.known_for_zh: 元杂剧最重要的剧作家。

people.name: Ma Zhiyuan
people.known_for: Playwright and sanqu poet, best known for a short poem on autumn longing.
people.known_for_zh: 元曲作家，以小令《天净沙·秋思》最为著名。
people.line_zh: 枯藤老树昏鸦，小桥流水人家，古道西风瘦马。
people.line_en: Withered vines, old trees, crows at dusk; a small bridge, flowing water, homes; an old road, west wind, a thin horse.

people.name: Guo Shoujing
people.known_for: Astronomer and water engineer who built new instruments and canals for Kublai Khan.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家和水利专家，为忽必烈制造天文仪器、开凿运河。

people.name: Huang Daopo
people.known_for: Woman who brought Hainan cotton-spinning methods to Songjiang and improved its tools.
people.known_for_zh: 把海南黎族的棉纺技术带回松江并改进工具的女纺织家。

people.name: Phagpa
people.known_for: Sakya lama and Kublai's Imperial Preceptor, who created the 'Phags-pa script.
people.known_for_zh: 萨迦派高僧，忽必烈的帝师，创制八思巴文。

people.name: Zhao Mengfu
people.known_for: Song prince who served the Yuan; a master painter and calligrapher.
people.known_for_zh: 宋宗室出仕元朝，书画大家，“赵体”书法影响深远。

works.title: Autumn Colours on the Qiao and Hua Mountains

people.name: Huang Gongwang
people.known_for: Landscape painter whose long scroll of the Fuchun Mountains is one of China's most famous paintings.
people.known_for_zh: 山水画家，《富春山居图》是中国最著名的画作之一。

people.name: Ni Zan
people.known_for: Painter of sparse, quiet river landscapes, one of the Four Masters of the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 元四家之一，画风萧疏淡远。

people.name: Marco Polo
people.known_for: Venetian merchant whose book about Kublai's China made it famous in Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 威尼斯商人，他关于忽必烈时代中国的游记使中国在欧洲闻名。

people.name: Zhu Shijie
people.known_for: Mathematician who solved systems of equations in up to four unknowns (1303).
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，1303年著书解四元高次方程组。

works.title: Jade Mirror of the Four Unknowns

people.name: Zhu Danxi
people.known_for: One of the Four Great Physicians of the Jin-Yuan period, who stressed nourishing yin.
people.known_for_zh: 金元四大家之一，倡导“滋阴”学说。

people.name: Wang Dayuan
people.known_for: Sailed twice from Quanzhou across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean and wrote an account (1349).
people.known_for_zh: 两次从泉州出海远航东南亚和印度洋，1349年写成游记。

works.title: A Brief Account of the Island Barbarians

people.name: Kublai Khan
people.known_for: Founded the Yuan dynasty in 1271, built Dadu as capital and completed the conquest of the Song.
people.known_for_zh: 元朝开国皇帝，定都大都，统一中国。

people.name: Bayan of the Baarin
people.known_for: Mongol commander who led the conquest of the Southern Song and took Lin'an in 1276.
people.known_for_zh: 元朝名将，统军灭南宋，攻克临安。

people.name: Wen Tianxiang
people.known_for: Song chancellor who led resistance against the Mongols and was executed in Dadu after refusing to serve the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 抗元名臣，被俘不屈，就义于大都。

people.name: Lu Xiufu
people.known_for: Song minister who leapt into the sea with the child emperor after the defeat at Yamen in 1279.
people.known_for_zh: 崖山海战败后背负幼帝投海殉国。

people.name: Zhang Hongfan
people.known_for: Han Chinese Yuan general who destroyed the last Song fleet at the Battle of Yamen.
people.known_for_zh: 元朝汉人将领，崖山海战消灭南宋残部。

people.name: Liu Bingzhong
people.known_for: Advisor to Kublai who proposed the dynastic name Yuan and planned the capitals Shangdu and Dadu.
people.known_for_zh: 忽必烈谋臣，建议国号“大元”，规划上都与大都。

people.name: Ahmad Fanakati
people.known_for: Central Asian finance minister of Kublai Khan, assassinated in 1282.
people.known_for_zh: 忽必烈的理财大臣，1282年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Xu Heng
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian who made Zhu Xi's teachings the basis of Yuan education and helped devise the Shoushi calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 元代理学家，主持国子学，参修《授时历》。

people.name: Wu Cheng
people.known_for: Leading Yuan Neo-Confucian who sought to reconcile Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan.
people.known_for_zh: 元代理学大家，调和朱陆之学。

people.name: Wang Shifu
people.known_for: Playwright of the zaju drama Romance of the Western Chamber.
people.known_for_zh: 元杂剧作家，著《西厢记》。

people.name: Bai Pu
people.known_for: Yuan dramatist, one of the Four Great Yuan Playwrights.
people.known_for_zh: 元曲四大家之一，著《梧桐雨》《墙头马上》。

people.name: Zhang Yanghao
people.known_for: Official and sanqu poet known for compassion for the suffering common people.
people.known_for_zh: 元代散曲家，“兴，百姓苦；亡，百姓苦”。

works.title: Meditation on the Past at Tong Pass

people.name: Wang Mian
people.known_for: Painter and poet famed for ink plum blossoms, who refused official service.
people.known_for_zh: 元代画家，以墨梅著称。

people.name: Wu Zhen
people.known_for: Reclusive landscape painter, one of the Four Masters of the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 元四家之一，擅画渔父与墨竹。

people.name: Wang Meng
people.known_for: Landscape painter with dense textured brushwork, one of the Four Masters of the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 元四家之一，赵孟頫外孙，山水繁密。

people.name: Qian Xuan
people.known_for: Song loyalist painter who revived archaic blue-green styles and refused to serve the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 宋遗民画家，“吴兴八俊”之一。

people.name: Wang Zhen
people.known_for: Agronomist who wrote the Nong Shu and invented wooden movable type with a rotating type case.
people.known_for_zh: 著《农书》，创制木活字与转轮排字盘。

people.name: Rabban Bar Sauma
people.known_for: Nestorian monk from Dadu who travelled to Persia and Europe, meeting the Pope and European kings.
people.known_for_zh: 大都景教僧，西行至波斯与欧洲，谒见教皇。

people.name: Zhou Daguan
people.known_for: Envoy who visited Angkor in 1296–1297 and wrote the only contemporary account of it.
people.known_for_zh: 出使真腊，著《真腊风土记》。

people.name: Ibn Battuta
people.known_for: Moroccan traveller who visited Quanzhou and other Chinese cities around 1345.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥旅行家，约1345年游历泉州等地。

people.name: Odoric of Pordenone
people.known_for: Franciscan friar who travelled through China in the 1320s and described it to Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 意大利方济各会士，游历元朝并留下游记。

people.name: John of Montecorvino
people.known_for: Franciscan missionary who founded the Catholic mission in Dadu and became its first archbishop.
people.known_for_zh: 来华传教士，首任汗八里总主教。

people.name: Toqto'a
people.known_for: Yuan chancellor who directed the official histories of Song, Liao and Jin and the Yellow River repairs.
people.known_for_zh: 元末丞相，主修宋、辽、金三史。

people.name: Liu Futong
people.known_for: Leader of the Red Turban Rebellion who established the Song regime of Han Lin'er at Bozhou.
people.known_for_zh: 红巾军领袖，拥立韩林儿建立宋政权。

people.name: Chen Youliang
people.known_for: Rebel ruler of Han who was killed by Zhu Yuanzhang at the Battle of Lake Poyang.
people.known_for_zh: 元末群雄之一，鄱阳湖之战败死。

people.name: Zhang Shicheng
people.known_for: Salt-smuggler turned rebel king who ruled the wealthy Suzhou region until defeated by Zhu Yuanzhang.
people.known_for_zh: 元末割据江浙的群雄，据守平江。

people.name: Yang Weizhen
people.known_for: Unconventional poet and calligrapher who led late Yuan literary circles.
people.known_for_zh: 元末诗坛领袖，“铁崖体”诗风。

people.name: Hu Sanxing
people.known_for: Song loyalist who wrote the standard commentary on the Zizhi Tongjian.
people.known_for_zh: 宋遗民史学家，作《资治通鉴音注》。

people.name: Ma Duanlin
people.known_for: Compiled the encyclopedic institutional history Wenxian Tongkao.
people.known_for_zh: 著典章制度通史《文献通考》。

people.name: Araniko
people.known_for: Nepalese artist-architect who designed the White Stupa of Miaoying Temple in Dadu.
people.known_for_zh: 尼泊尔工匠，设计大都妙应寺白塔。

people.name: Yang Hui
people.known_for: Mathematician who in 1261 published Pascal's triangle, crediting it to Jia Xian.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，1261年刊载“贾宪三角”（杨辉三角）。

works.title: Detailed Analysis of the Nine Chapters

people.name: Xu Da
people.known_for: Leading general of the Hongwu Emperor who captured Dadu (Beijing) in 1368 and drove the Yuan court north.
people.known_for_zh: 明朝开国第一功臣，1368年攻克元大都，驱逐蒙元。

people.name: Chang Yuchun
people.known_for: Fearless early Ming general who fought alongside Xu Da in the northern campaign against the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 明初猛将，与徐达共同北伐灭元，号称“常十万”。

people.name: Liu Ji (Liu Bowen)
people.known_for: Strategist and adviser to Zhu Yuanzhang, helping found the Ming; later legendary as a seer.
people.known_for_zh: 朱元璋的谋士，辅佐开创明朝，后世传为神机妙算的军师。

people.name: Li Shanchang
people.known_for: First chancellor of the Ming, organiser of the new state, executed in the Hu Weiyong purges.
people.known_for_zh: 明朝开国丞相，主持制度建设，后受胡惟庸案牵连被杀。

people.name: Song Lian
people.known_for: Leading early Ming scholar who directed compilation of the History of Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 明初文臣之首，主持编修《元史》。

people.name: Zhu Yuanzhang (Hongwu Emperor)
people.known_for: Peasant-born rebel who founded the Ming dynasty in 1368 and ruled autocratically from Nanjing.
people.known_for_zh: 出身贫农，1368年建立明朝，定都南京，强化皇权。

people.name: Luo Guanzhong
people.known_for: Author credited with the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, one of the Four Great Classical Novels.
people.known_for_zh: 元末明初小说家，著《三国演义》。

people.name: Shi Nai'an
people.known_for: Writer traditionally credited with the novel Water Margin.
people.known_for_zh: 元末明初小说家，相传著《水浒传》。

capitals.name: Dadu
capitals.note: Built to Kublai's plan; the core of later Beijing.
capitals.note_zh: 按忽必烈的规划新建，是后来北京城的基础。

capitals.name: Shangdu (Xanadu)
capitals.note: Summer capital; burned by the Red Turbans in 1358.
capitals.note_zh: 夏季都城，1358年被红巾军焚毁。

capitals.name: Fuzhou
capitals.note: Emperor Duanzong was enthroned here after Lin'an fell.
capitals.note_zh: 临安陷落后宋端宗在此即位。

capitals.name: Yashan
capitals.note: Last Song base; the court was destroyed at the battle of Yamen in 1279.
capitals.note_zh: 南宋最后据点，1279年崖山海战后灭亡。

capitals.name: Yingtian
capitals.note: Zhu Yuanzhang's base, which became the first Ming capital.
capitals.note_zh: 朱元璋的根据地，后成为明朝首都。
